conventions.description: Put a file in the right place — the platform discovers it. No config, no registration.

testing.heading: Test against real projects
testing.description: Specimens are real project snapshots on orphan branches. Any skill that operates on source code can use them.
testing.footer: Delta branches add targeted changes with intentional findings for testing edge cases.

delivery.heading: Flexible delivery. Use what works for you.
delivery.description: The platform is an abstract idea that structures your AI resources and helps you manage them. That's it. How you deliver them to developers is entirely up to you.

forge.title: Forge CLI
forge.description: Recommended. Set-and-forget sync with auto-transforms for every AI tool. The easiest path.

submodules.title: Git submodules
submodules.description: Classic approach. Add the platform repo as a submodule and symlink what you need.

custom.title: Custom tooling
custom.description: Already have a delivery mechanism? The platform's directory conventions work with any tool that can read a git repo.

withForge.heading: Best with Forge
withForge.description: Fork the starter, build your team's skills, then deliver to every developer with Forge. Configure once, forget it exists.
